story.title: Ava's Kitchen Science Adventure
story.introLine: Hi Ava! Let's discover the magic of matter while we cook something yummy!
story.closingLine: Now it's your turn to help me sort these ingredients by their state of matter!

scenes.title: The Busy Kitchen
scenes.narration: Look at all these things! We have solid wooden spoons, liquid milk in a glass, and steam rising from a pot like a gas. Everything we touch is made of matter.
scenes.imagePrompt: A bright, colorful kitchen with a wooden spoon, a glass of milk, and a steaming pot on a stove, polished 2d children educational game art, no text.

scenes.title: The Science of Soup
scenes.narration: When we cook, matter can change! Ice cubes are solids that melt into liquid water, and boiling water turns into gas clouds. It is like magic, but it is actually science!
scenes.imagePrompt: A close-up of ice cubes melting in a bowl and steam swirling above a soup pot, vibrant colors, polished 2d children educational game art, no text.

narration.transcript: Hi Ava! Let's discover the magic of matter while we cook something yummy! Look at all these things! We have solid wooden spoons, liquid milk in a glass, and steam rising from a pot like a gas. Everything we touch is made of matter. When we cook, matter can change! Ice cubes are solids that melt into liquid water, and boiling water turns into gas clouds. It is like magic, but it is actually science! Now it's your turn to help me sort these ingredients by their state of matter!
